title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.4.8
summary: Technician Multiple Document & Proof Uploads Support
features: 📁 Multiple Document Uploads: Technicians can now upload multiple photos, videos, and documents when marking tickets resolved.
➕ Non-Replacing Append Flow: Adding subsequent photos or videos appends to the list instead of replacing the previous file.
🗑️ Individual File Management: Preview thumbnails, file size indicators, and individual remove buttons for attached proofs.
